description: Every listed wine company VINCAP tracks (index constituents and tracked companies), ranked on the weights you set, 0-5 each: growth (revenue growth, latest period), margin (net margin), y1 (1-year share price), wine (wine share of revenue), from_high (further below the 52-week high scores higher). Each company scores by its percentile inside the universe; one missing a weighted figure is listed unscored, never scored as zero. Each row carries the figures and the results period. Example: {"weights":{"growth":2,"margin":3},"include":"index"}

include.description: all (default), index constituents only, or tracked companies outside the index

weights.description: 0-5 per metric; omitted = growth 2, margin 3, y1 1

name: rank_wine_companies
title: Rank listed wine companies
